article.story: FAIRFAX, Va. -- — Baraka Okojie had 14 points in George Mason’s 68-51 win against Coppin State on Friday. Okojie also contributed three steals for the Patriots (2-0). Shane Pendergrass scored 13 points, going 5 of 8 (1 for 3 from 3-point range). Emmanuel Kanga shot 5 of 8 from the field to finish with 11 points. Tafara Gapare finished with 12 points for the Eagles (0-2). Coppin State also got eight points from Brendan Johnson. Malik Shackleford also had eight points. George Mason took the lead for good with 19:34 left in the first half. The score was 46-23 at halftime, with Pendergrass racking up nine points. George Mason was outscored by Coppin State in the second half by a six-point margin, but still wound up on top, while Okojie led the way with a team-high six second-half points. Up next George Mason plays UMKC on Thursday, and Coppin State hosts Cheyney on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
